Acme Soda sponsors local fun run

Published 2024-03-01

Acme Soda sponsored a local fun run in its home town last spring. About two hundred runners took part in the event, which raised money for the town library and local schools.

The company handed out free sodas at the finish line and thanked volunteers for their help. It was the third year the company had supported the small community race and its organizers.
